note: Data items inside .text: switch jump tables (absolute code addresses) and 0xCC padding at the end of function spans are structured; the byte index tables that follow some tables are listed by extent only (index_tables) and stay hash-referenced data ranges. Offsets are file offsets (equal to RVAs in .text). Derived by M02's own heuristic (jmp [reg*4+table] references, in-span code addresses, index bytes smaller than the entry count); M03's per-function split supersedes it.
